## 页间 v0.1.24

- **Windows** — `yejian-v0.1.24-windows-x64.exe`，x64 安装包。
- **Android** — `yejian-v0.1.24-android.apk`，沿用正式签名的通用安装包。已安装正式版的用户可覆盖升级。旧调试版用户请先导出书库备份，再按[迁移步骤](https://github.com/itcwc/yejian-reader/releases/tag/v0.1.21)操作。
- **macOS / Linux** — 同版本的 DMG、AppImage 和 `.deb` 通过 GitHub Releases 的桌面预发布版本提供。

### English

The stable release includes the Windows x64 installer and the release-signed universal Android APK. If you are migrating from an Android debug build, export a library backup and follow the [migration guide](https://github.com/itcwc/yejian-reader/releases/tag/v0.1.21). macOS and Linux packages are distributed in a separate desktop pre-release.
